quests.title: Fisharium Open For Business!

dialogue.t: Oh, you've been bringing back so many fish lately. The aquarium is starting to look like a real ocean habitat.
Hehehe, we're practically pro fishie-fetchers already!
You appear to take great pride in your work.
You betcha! But behind the sense of accomplishment, there's something else... something more like...
Yeah, that's it! That's how Paimon's feeling underneath.
Why is that?
Paimon's not sure... It just feels like something's missing...
Hey! Don't say stuff like that! How could anyone bear to eat such beautiful fishies!?
We're missing visitors to come and admire our amazing handiwork!
You're saying... you want to open the aquarium to visitors?
Would that not be okay?

dialogue.sit: Are you worried it'll be too noisy?
Are you worried it'll cause lots of problems?

dialogue.t: If that's the case, just leave everything to us! We'll take care of advertising and all the day-to-day stuff — you just focus on your own work.
If that's what you want...
Huh...? We only get 70%?
Oh, right, of course... Sandrone is the one renting this boat, after all...
Ugh, you make me sound like some sort of tyrannical landlord. You're putting in the work, so you should get the lion's share. I'm not stingy like Pantalone.
So that means... you're giving us the all-clear?
Sure, you have my blessing. Just make sure it doesn't get in the way of my research.
Woohoo! The Wingalet Gloop-Gloop Funderwater Fisharium is officially open for business!
*sigh* Of course you already thought of a name...

quests.description: Sandrone seems to be looking for us…
